snippet.title: Pokémon GO | Pokémon GO Fest 2025: Max Finale
snippet.description:
Pokémon GO Fest 2025: Max Finale is coming soon! Max Pokémon will be appearing one after another. And Eternatus will be appearing for the first time globally!

Use promo code "GOFESTMAX" to get a chance to catch a powerful Gigantamax Pokémon!

Find all your favorite Pokémon merchandise at the official Pokémon Center: https://www.pokemoncenter.com/
